title: WkDoctor: System Physician (T2 howto)
desc: T2 howto tier. Practical commands for system health, Defender optimization, and emergency process cleanup.
steps: HEALTH CHECK: run 'wkdoctor' (or 'wkdoctor -Json' for tools) to see overall system health. 17+ 'ok' checks is the target.
DEFENDER FIX: run 'wkdoctor -DefenderFix'. It will self-elevate via Admin Eye (approve UAC once). It resets old patterns and adds the current workspace root to exclusions.
EMERGENCY KILL: run 'wkdoctor -EmergencyKill'. It first ensures Defender is optimized (root cause), then kills high-interference processes (symptom) until CPU/RAM drop to 40%.
INTELLIGENT BYPASS: if 'wkdoctor -DefenderFix' is run and settings are already perfect, it exits quietly with 'Already optimized' to save time and token budget.
author: gemini
